logic_errors.title: Lease invalidation before its error event installs a pg-pool idle listener that can re-emit an unhandled pool error
logic_errors.observed: Supplemental real file-put handover intermittently failed with PG administrator-termination error. Exact reruns passed, so a deterministic event-order probe delayed actual dedicated-client error/end delivery until a protected request detected the missing pg_locks row. Runtime.check invalidated and release(true) attached pg-pool idleListener. Delivery of the already pending real PG error then emitted pool.error. With an observing pool listener, the leaked error was recorded; with no pool error listener (production configuration), the test threw the PG error. New HTTP work was already rejected with 503, but process availability remains unsafe.
logic_errors.expected: Every supported dedicated-lease loss ordering must invalidate/fence without an unhandled pool error, including ownership-check invalidation before delayed client error/end. Retaining the Runtime error listener alone does not suppress pg-pool forwarding.
logic_errors.scope_note: Controlled event-delivery scheduling of real PG termination on private local DB; no production/client implementation edited. Does not demonstrate stale tool writes or double inference. Original ordinary lease-loss probe now passes.

suggestions: Add this ownership-check-before-client-error ordering to the permanent runtime regression suite when fixing the remaining lease listener lifecycle issue. Do not weaken the corrected assertion to accept a pool error.

Shared handover barrier drains actual old artifact and file-put writes before recovery; old product writes roll back.

Ordinary lease error and end invalidate runtime; healthy DB persists unknown independently of a held file read; old/new runtime, cancel/purge and listener cleanup controls pass. Delayed error after ownership-check invalidation remains broken.

Ordinary file-put isolated controls and 10 repeats pass but do not clear this ordering defect.
